title: Denovo
claim: Product Hunt: Denovo — Turn your vibe-coded app into paying customers
why_good: Denovo is a business manager for indie app creators that helps them transition from free users to paying customers by providing actionable insights and tools to optimize monetization strategies, including pricing experiments and conversion tracking.
value: Indie app creators pay for a tool that helps them convert free users into paying customers, enabling sustainable revenue growth without hiring a business consultant.
risk: If major analytics platforms or app marketplaces improve their monetization tools, Denovo could struggle to differentiate itself and attract users.
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score
does: A 'business manager' for indie app creators: monetization insights, pricing experiments, conversion tracking — the business-consultant layer for people who only know how to build.
why_use: Unlike generic analytics platforms, Denovo specifically caters to indie developers by focusing on monetization pain points and providing tailored solutions for converting users into revenue, without requiring deep business expertise.
gap: Vibe-coding produced a wave of builders with zero business skills, and tooling for 'make my toy app make money' is thin — but this entry needs first-hand evidence (a paying user, an earnest complaint) before promotion.
counter: App stores, Stripe and analytics platforms all sit closer to the money; 'insights' products die the moment the advice doesn't visibly move revenue.
differentiator: If evidence appears: the Chinese indie / 小程序 developer side is even more underserved than the English one.
hook: Indie vibe-coders who shipped an app but can't turn free users into revenue — 285 PH upvotes say the anxiety is real; paying evidence is not yet checkable.

zh.claim: Denovo — 将您的酷炫应用转化为付费客户
zh.hook: 能把 app 写出来、却不会把免费用户变成收入的独立开发者——285 个 PH 赞说明焦虑是真的；付费证据暂时无法核查。
zh.does: 独立开发者的『生意管家』：变现洞察、定价实验、转化追踪——给只会写代码的人补上商业顾问这一层。
zh.why_use: 与通用分析平台不同，Denovo 专门针对独立开发者的货币化痛点，提供无需深入商业知识的定制解决方案来实现用户转化为收入。
zh.gap: vibe-coding 造出了一大批毫无商业技能的开发者，『让我的小 app 赚钱』的工具还很薄——但这条需要一手证据（一个付费用户、一句认真的抱怨）才能升档。
zh.counter: 应用商店、Stripe、各分析平台都比它离钱更近；『洞察』类产品在建议无法直接抬收入的那一刻就死了。
zh.differentiator: 若证据出现：中文独立开发者/小程序侧比英文侧更空。
zh.value: 独立应用开发者为一个工具付费，该工具帮助他们将免费用户转化为付费客户，从而实现可持续收入增长，无需聘请商业顾问。
zh.risk: 如果主流分析平台或应用市场改进其货币化工具，Denovo 可能难以区分自己并吸引用户。
zh.why_good: Denovo 是一个面向独立应用开发者的业务管理工具，通过提供可操作的洞察和工具来优化货币化策略，包括定价实验和转化跟踪，帮助他们将免费用户转化为付费客户。
zh.consumer_angle: 独立开发者在这里就是消费者——他们像买课一样买它，而不是像买 SaaS。

consumer_angle: Indie creators are consumers here — they buy it like a course, not like SaaS.
